purpose: Make automatic permissions, forbidden actions, limit behavior, unaffected work, and clearing evidence explicit for immutable governance, owner authority, derived operations, and temporary probes.
constitutional_rule: The canonical constitutional set is immutable and cannot be removed, reordered, weakened, or shadowed by project context.
owner_rule: Owner-sovereign rows preserve current owner intent for outcome, audience, data, spending, source custody, promotion, licensing, maintenance, and destructive actions.
derived_rule: Derived operating rows calculate limits from the project life, technical, and delivery contracts; they normally throttle or warn rather than interrupt unrelated work.
probe_rule: Temporary probes are read-only and may leave external authentication, spending, publication, deployment, and rollback unproven.
conflict_rule: The more restrictive boundary wins. A project extension may add a stricter boundary but cannot override the portable kernel or owner authority.
hold_rule: A true boundary holds only the dependent outcome; unaffected work continues.

binding.context: typed Project Context carries the complete boundary contract and its digest
